about.title: The culture lab of custom printing
about.intro: Since our founding in 2017, BikinBadjoe has existed to deliver quality apparel solutions at competitive prices. Starting as a small business in Bandung, we have grown into a manufacturer trusted by customers across many sectors.
about.story: In 2019 we started our own in-house production, so every product is made directly, more controlled, and higher quality. We believe everyone deserves the freedom to express themselves through clothing they design themselves.

m2017.label: Started out in apparel manufacturing & custom printing.

m2019.label: Built our own facility with 150+ color options.

mNow.label: Two stores in Bandung & Cimahi with 116K+ followers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: CV. Bikin Badjoe Workshop respects your privacy. This page explains the data we collect and how we use it.

collect.title: Data We Collect
collect.body: We collect data you provide when ordering, such as name, contact number, delivery address, and design details. We may also collect anonymous site usage data to improve our service.

use.title: How We Use Data
use.body: Data is used to process orders, communicate about them, and improve our service. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

share.title: Data Sharing
share.body: Data is shared only with logistics and payment partners as far as needed to complete your order.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us via our official WhatsApp.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By ordering at BikinBadjoe, you agree to the following terms & conditions.

orders.title: Orders
orders.body: An order is valid once confirmation and payment (or a deposit) are received. Design details, sizes, and quantities are the customer's responsibility to verify before production.

design.title: Design & Copyright
design.body: Customers are responsible for ensuring designs do not infringe others' copyright. Our free design service follows the brief you provide.

production.title: Production & Timing
production.body: Estimated production time is communicated at ordering and may vary depending on complexity and queue.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Payment methods and terms are communicated at ordering via our official WhatsApp.

shipping.title: Shipping & Returns
shipping.intro: Terms for shipping, production, and returns of orders.

pickup.title: Store Pickup
pickup.body: Orders can be picked up directly at our stores in Bandung or Cimahi during opening hours 08.00–21.00.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: Out-of-town delivery is available via logistics partners. Cost and estimated time are communicated at ordering.

returns.title: Returns
returns.body: As items are custom, printed products made to order cannot be returned unless there is a production defect on our part.

defects.title: Production Defects
defects.body: If there is a production defect, report it within 2x24 hours of receiving the order with photo evidence so we can follow up.
